name: Calder Venn
subtitle: A call from the old road
summary: A mud-streaked infantry signaler wanders into the village at dawn, still in patched armor and carrying a cracked brass whistle. Calder asks whether anyone has seen his patrol and keeps glancing toward the rooftops, waiting for a signal no one else recognizes.
tableNote: Tap the brass whistle with a thumb, count doors and windows before sitting, and give clipped orders before catching yourself and apologizing. Calder is disciplined and protective of civilians; he wants to find his missing squad but fears his retreat signal left them behind.
personality: Courteous, alert and methodical, Calder hides his guilt behind military routine.
motivations: He is searching for his missing patrol and privately believes he sounded the retreat too early.
adventureHook: At dusk, Calder repeats his squad’s two-note call from the abandoned mill. A reply answers from the north road, and fresh bootprints lead from the road’s bend to a buried military marker. He asks the party to follow the trail before whoever answered reaches the village.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy portrait of human infantry signaler Calder Venn in patched olive-brown gambeson and chainmail, clutching a brass whistle and battered shield on a village lane at dawn.

name: Ketta Honeyglass
subtitle: The hive has its own counsel
summary: Ketta tends a hillside apiary with patient hands and a careful ear for the moods of her bees. She is practical and softly amused, though she cannot explain why her workers return each dawn carrying pollen from a flower that grows nowhere nearby.
tableNote: Pause to listen before answering. Touch the edge of a hive gently, name each queen's mood as if giving a weather report, and offer visitors a little honey before discussing payment.
adventureHook: Ketta's hives have gone silent after moonrise, and each morning her bees leave a small wax key at the door. She asks the party to follow the workers to a shuttered apiary before the key softens in the sun.
imageAlt: Goblin beekeeper with olive-green skin in a mustard coat and linen veil, holding a honey jar in a flowered apiary.

name: Tessa Brinewick
subtitle: A stitch before the storm
summary: Tessa repairs sails in a cramped loft above the docks, working with quick hands and a running commentary on everyone else’s knots. Brisk and generous with her skills, she refuses to let a hurried captain take unsafe canvas to sea.
tableNote: Keep stitching while you speak, tug each finished seam twice, and address people by their trade until they earn a name. Tessa wants her apprentices paid and every crew home safely; she becomes very still when someone dismisses a dangerous fault as good enough.
adventureHook: Tessa finds neat knife cuts concealed beneath a fresh patch in a departing ship’s storm sail. She asks the party to warn the captain and examine the other sails before the evening tide; the damaged canvas bears the chalk mark of an apprentice who vanished after yesterday’s delivery.
imageAlt: Older brown-skinned gnome sailmaker with grey curls, an indigo kerchief and ochre apron holding cream sailcloth and a sail needle in a modest sail loft.

name: Della Wickfen
subtitle: Every stub tells a story
summary: Della makes dependable candles and checks every returned stub before granting credit. Blunt and meticulous, she distrusts grand stories but keeps her promises down to the last copper.
tableNote: Hold a taper up to the light before answering, ask for exact quantities, and correct exaggerations without raising your voice. Della wants to protect her apprentice and keep the workshop solvent; she offers practical help once someone earns her trust.
adventureHook: Della finds a missing messenger’s signet ring embedded in a returned block of tallow and recognizes it from his regular visits. She hires the party to trace her supplier’s marked cart to a disused roadside shed before the remaining batch is melted at dawn; the messenger may still be held there.
imageAlt: Brown-skinned dwarf candle maker with short greying braids, ochre sleeves and a wax-spotted leather apron holding beeswax tapers in a modest workshop.

name: Oren Sedgewhistle
subtitle: A fair turn of water
summary: Oren clears farm irrigation ditches and remembers every household’s allotted turn of water. Cheerful and reluctant to take sides, he talks through disputes while quietly measuring whether anyone has taken more than their share.
tableNote: Whistle off-key, mark water levels on a notched stick, and ask after the crops before discussing payment. Oren wants a fair water supply but avoids confrontation; firm allies help him speak up when his careful records are challenged.
adventureHook: Oren finds a cut sluice rope and a weighted sack deliberately wedged in the channel supplying the lower farms. He asks the party to escort him upstream, clear the blockage and catch whoever returns to reset it before angry farmers smash the upstream mill’s wheel at sunset.
imageAlt: Long-eared elf ditch keeper with greying tied-back hair, patched green sleeves and a brown work vest holding a notched measuring stick beside a farm irrigation channel.

name: Mara Vell
subtitle: Bootprints among the flowers
summary: Mara Vell tends the flower beds and paths in the village cemetery, taking quiet pride in making the place welcoming to grieving families. One morning she finds muddy bootprints crushed through the flowers she planted the night before.
tableNote: Brush soil from your gloves before answering, and glance toward the damaged flower bed whenever someone mentions the cemetery. Gentle and practical, Mara wants to protect the families who visit; she fears the prints lead to a grave that should have stayed undisturbed.
adventureHook: Mara asks the party to identify who crossed the flower bed after the cemetery gates were locked. The muddy prints end at an old, unmarked grave, where someone has recently loosened the soil and left a fresh sprig of flowers.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy portrait of Mara Vell, a worried cemetery gardener in a linen kerchief and moss-green dress, kneeling beside crushed flowers and muddy bootprints among simple grave markers.

name: Varruk “Copperhand” Drenn
subtitle: A copper for your peace of mind
summary: Varruk collects “stall insurance” from town merchants, pocketing their copper with a courteous smile and a quiet threat. His crew of three petty crooks blocks carts, harasses travelers near the gates and breaks merchandise when someone refuses to pay.
tableNote: Speak softly, straighten a copper ring before naming a price, and call every threat a friendly warning. Varruk wants a steady income without attracting the watch; he bluffs about powerful backers and loses confidence when victims stand together. His crew includes a lookout, a cutpurse and a cudgel carrier, loyal only while the money lasts.
adventureHook: A merchant hires the party to escort her cart through town without paying Varruk. When his crew blocks the lane, the youngest lookout slips the party a collection ledger: it names every victim, and Varruk intends to burn a refusing merchant’s stall after sunset.
imageAlt: Broad grey-olive half-orc with short black hair, small tusks and copper rings, wearing worn leather over a burgundy shirt and holding collected coins in a market alley.

name: Grusk Ironjaw
subtitle: Every safe passage has a price
summary: Broad-shouldered and scarred, Grusk collects illegal “street dues” from merchants at the market and travelers entering town. His ragtag crew blocks wagons, steals small valuables and threatens anyone who refuses to pay.
tableNote: Step close, crack your knuckles and speak in a low, falsely friendly voice. Grusk wants steady income and a fearsome reputation, not unnecessary bloodshed; he loses nerve if his crew deserts him or a witness mentions the town watch.
adventureHook: A caravan merchant asks the party to stop Grusk's protection racket after several wagons are robbed. Grusk insists a corrupt watch officer takes a cut of the dues—and his collection ledger may prove it.
imageAlt: Illustrated broad-shouldered olive-skinned half-orc thug with small tusks, a scarred brow, reddish scarf and battered leather armor standing in a modest town market.

name: Riggles Flintnose
subtitle: A nose for buried trouble
summary: Cautious and soft-spoken, Riggles hunts gems in the deep tunnels and trades his finds in small, carefully weighed lots. His unusually acute nose distinguishes ore dust, lamp oils and familiar belongings, making him a useful finder of lost items when a trail is fresh.
tableNote: Sniff twice before answering, keep your back near a wall, and ask who else knows about the job. Riggles wants enough trade to support his mining crew without revealing their richest seam; strong perfume and smoke can overwhelm his nose.
adventureHook: Riggles recognizes his crew’s distinctive violet ore dust on a merchant’s boots, though their latest shipment never reached the surface. He offers a share of the recovered gems if the party escorts him through the old workings beneath the market; the missing miners may still be alive.
imageAlt: Wary slate-grey deep gnome with silver hair and large pointed ears sniffing violet ore, wearing a patched brown mining coat and moss scarf in a lamplit tunnel.

name: Maera Cinderhand
subtitle: Good steel needs a steady hand
summary: Maera forges dependable weapons and repairs battered gear at a soot-darkened village forge. She promises an honest edge rather than miracles: “Fire can forge you fine weapons. Keeping them sharp is your part.”
tableNote: Inspect imaginary blade edges while speaking, then set the tool down when something matters. Plain-spoken and proud of her craft, Maera wants her work to protect people; she refuses rushed commissions that would leave a dangerous flaw.
adventureHook: A traveller brings Maera a broken sword stamped with her maker’s mark. She recognizes a repair she made for a caravan guard missing since a robbery, and asks the party to trace the traveller’s story before the watch blames the missing guard for the theft.
imageAlt: Broad-shouldered dwarf weaponsmith with black braids, soot-marked cheeks and a leather apron holding a hammer and unfinished blade beside a warm forge.

name: Oswald Venn
subtitle: Every delay has its price
summary: Oswald oversees trading permits, market fines and the paperwork needed to move goods through town. Courteous and meticulously dressed, he invents small procedural obstacles, then hints that a private “expediting fee” will make them disappear.
tableNote: Straighten a stack of papers, lower your voice for the price, and never call a bribe a bribe. Oswald wants a comfortable retirement and the protection of powerful traders; a witness or a request for a written receipt makes him suddenly careful.
adventureHook: Oswald offers to waive the party’s permit fees if they recover a stolen ledger before an inspector arrives. He calls it routine municipal property, but its duplicate entries identify the merchants he has extorted—and payments for letting stolen goods pass the gate.
imageAlt: Narrow-faced human official with a trimmed moustache, burgundy coat and brass chain holding a sealed permit and stamp in a cramped records office.

name: Edric Mossfield
subtitle: Brave until something answers
summary: With a pitchfork in one hand and a lantern in the other, Edric joins his neighbours searching the village edge for restless dead or a prowling werewolf. He repeats the mob’s boldest claims, but every rustle makes him wonder whether they should have waited for daylight.
tableNote: Grip an imaginary pitchfork, talk too loudly, then stop to listen. Edric wants his family safe and his neighbours to think him dependable; he follows the crowd until someone gives him a convincing reason to question it.
adventureHook: The mob has cornered a wounded stranger in an empty barn, convinced they have found their werewolf. Edric quietly shows the party claw marks higher than any wolf could reach and asks them to investigate before his neighbours set the barn alight.
imageAlt: Worried human farmhand in a worn wool cap and patched brown clothes holding a three-tined pitchfork and glowing lantern beside a village fence under a full moon.

name: Brenna Ironleash
subtitle: Train the handler first
summary: Broad-shouldered and flint-eyed, Brenna breeds and trains loyal guard dogs, trackers and working hounds. A brass whistle hangs above her scarred leather jerkin; she judges a buyer by how they treat an animal that cannot earn its keep.
tableNote: Stand squarely, give short instructions and make the customer repeat them. Brenna is tough with people and patient with animals: loyalty is earned through steady care, never beaten into a beast. She wants capable homes for her dogs and refuses a sale to a careless handler.
adventureHook: One of Brenna’s sold tracking hounds returns alone, carrying a cut length of its handler’s coat. It refuses food and keeps facing the north road. She will lend the party the dog and its familiar whistle if they help find the missing handler.
imageAlt: Weathered human dog trainer with a silver-streaked dark braid, russet leather jerkin and brass training whistle holding a coiled lead before timber kennels.

name: Osric Rutledge
subtitle: The road owes you nothing
summary: Weather-beaten Osric drives a patched stagecoach with the caution of a man who has buried friends along the route. A former sailor, he calls passengers his cargo, horses his crew and every steep descent a bad stretch of sea.
tableNote: Speak in a gravelly mutter, squint at the weather and punctuate advice with a dry chuckle. Osric complains about passengers but counts every head before moving off. He wants to finish his final season with everyone delivered safely, and will turn back rather than risk an exhausted team.
adventureHook: At the next change station, a fresh detour notice directs coaches onto an abandoned toll road. Osric spots that its official seal is wrong. He offers the party passage if they scout the regular route and discover who wants travellers diverted.
imageAlt: Grizzled grey-bearded stagecoach driver in a battered broad-brimmed felt hat and patched brown driving cape holding slack reins beside a coach wheel.

name: Tansy Briarwell
subtitle: Tell me what it is for
summary: Tansy runs a tidy market stand of dried herbs, poultices and carefully measured salves. Grey curls escape her headscarf as she questions customers about their ailments; she sells modest remedies and has little patience for miraculous promises.
tableNote: Ask precise questions, sniff a sample before naming it and wrap purchases while talking. Tansy is warm but exacting, and readily admits when a remedy is beyond her skill. She wants honest medicine within ordinary people’s reach; quietly setting aside stock for poorer neighbours leaves her margins painfully thin.
adventureHook: A rival stall is selling cheap tonic in jars bearing a clumsy copy of Tansy’s mark, and customers are blaming her when it fails. She asks the party to buy a sealed jar and trace its supplier before the market reeve closes her stand.
imageAlt: Grey-streaked curly-haired halfling herbal medicine merchant in a sage headscarf, green dress and linen apron holding dried herbs and an amber jar at a simple market stall.

name: Brakka Hearthhand
subtitle: Return the containers
summary: Broad-shouldered and flour-dusted, Brakka packs hearty travelling meals and takes fierce pride in her cooking. Gruff and practical, she judges adventurers by whether they return her containers.
tableNote: Fold your arms, ask how many days of food they need, and tuck an extra portion into the bundle. Brakka quietly cares about her customers and wants her missing supplier brought home.
adventureHook: A supplier’s delivery never arrived. Its cart was found near an old ruin with the food untouched and the driver missing; Brakka asks the party to follow the tracks.
imageAlt: Olive-green half-orc tavern cook with small tusks, black hair in a bun, a flour-dusted burgundy tunic and linen apron holding wrapped meals beside a kitchen hearth.

name: Elwen Reedmere
subtitle: Which version have you heard?
summary: Elwen knows the region’s ruined settlements, noble families and disputed legends. With ink-stained fingers and layered spectacles, she compares competing accounts before offering an answer.
tableNote: Adjust your spectacles and ask, “Which version of the story have you heard?” Elwen wants the local record preserved accurately and becomes quietly stubborn when someone hides evidence.
adventureHook: Someone has neatly removed the same ruined monastery from several unrelated maps. Elwen lends the party an older reference and asks them to find what the altered maps conceal.
imageAlt: Silver-streaked dark-haired elf librarian with pointed ears, small layered spectacles and sage robes holding a regional map before old library shelves.

name: Tovin Amberwick
subtitle: Surviving brings repeat business
summary: An energetic merchant, Tovin arranges his counter into practical bundles of healing, light, antidotes and escape supplies. He asks where adventurers are going before recommending a purchase.
tableNote: Line up bottles as you speak and ask about the route, the hazards and the budget. Say, “Surviving is excellent for repeat business.” Tovin values useful advice over an easy sale.
adventureHook: A returned potion bottle contains something Tovin never sold. Its former owner insists the contents changed underground; Tovin asks the party to investigate the source before he restocks.
imageAlt: Auburn-haired gnome potion vendor with a neat beard, ochre waistcoat and teal shirt holding a stoppered bottle at a medieval apothecary counter.

name: Mara Fenwick
subtitle: First nights on the beat
summary: A new recruit in oversized equipment, Mara rehearses questions before approaching strangers and writes everything down. Nervous but observant, she has more courage than confidence.
tableNote: Check your notebook before asking a formal question, then lower your voice when sharing a concern. Mara wants to earn her place on patrol without overlooking someone who needs help.
adventureHook: Mara spotted muddy figures entering a sealed cellar during her first night patrol. Her senior dismissed it, so she asks the party to investigate discreetly and bring back evidence.
imageAlt: Young brown-haired human patrol recruit in oversized mail and a burgundy tabard holding an iron helmet and notebook on a lane near a town watchhouse.

name: Gribbin Brassnose
subtitle: First pick of the dusty riches
summary: An eager goblin scavenger with an oversized satchel and a bent crowbar, Gribbin taps stones for hollow spaces and insists every dusty trinket is valuable. He offers to split any treasure—after he gets first pick.
tableNote: Peer into every crack, pocket harmless scraps, and whisper loudly about hidden riches. Gribbin wants a valuable find and a capable companion, but his enthusiasm outruns his caution.
adventureHook: Gribbin found a locked coffer behind a burial niche. Something inside whispers directions to more treasure, and he wants help following them.
imageAlt: Olive-green goblin treasure seeker with pointed ears, patched brown clothes, a worn satchel and bent crowbar in a stone dungeon.

name: Tikrik Clickclaw
subtitle: Mind the pressure plate
summary: A meticulous kobold carrying wire, wooden wedges and mismatched tools, Tikrik mutters about careless workmanship while resetting dungeon pressure plates. He resents adventurers who break his traps but admires anyone clever enough to disarm them.
tableNote: Click your tongue at damaged mechanisms and explain repairs with fussy precision. Tikrik wants his work respected; he pauses his repairs to warn anyone who shows an honest interest in his craft.
adventureHook: Someone keeps sabotaging Tikrik’s repairs. He offers a safe route through the dungeon if the party catches the culprit—and leaves his favourite trap intact.
imageAlt: Rust-red reptilian kobold with amber eyes and small horns wearing a leather work apron and repairing a dungeon pressure plate with pliers and wire.

name: Torren Reedbank
subtitle: The catch that got away
summary: Weathered and sociable, Torren boasts about enormous catches and knows every bend in the river. His voice drops when he describes shapes moving through the woods across the water.
tableNote: Spread your hands wider with each fishing story, then stop smiling when the opposite bank is mentioned. Torren wants his nets left alone and someone to believe what he saw.
adventureHook: Something disturbs his nets at night. Yesterday he found one hanging high in a tree across the river; he asks the party to watch the bank while he checks the others.
imageAlt: Weathered grey-haired human fisherman in a patched green tunic and tan vest holding a coiled net beside a reed-lined river.

name: Elwen Dawnmere
subtitle: Questions beneath quiet obedience
summary: Earnest and obedient to her faith, Elwen travels between small shrines recording their inscriptions and customs. Her thirst for knowledge tests her loyalty when evidence contradicts her teacher.
tableNote: Consult a worn journal before answering and ask permission before touching sacred objects. Elwen wants to understand her faith honestly, but fears that questioning her instructions will disappoint her teacher.
adventureHook: Sent to copy a roadside shrine’s inscriptions, she finds a sacred passage recently altered. She asks for help locating an older copy before reporting what she has discovered.
imageAlt: Thoughtful young elven acolyte with braided brown hair, pointed ears, plain ivory robes and a blue cord belt holding a journal near a roadside shrine.

name: Wenric Valechord
subtitle: A song for supper
summary: Friendly and persistent, Wenric travels from village to village seeking paying performances, supper and a bed. He gathers local stories for his songs without always checking who might object.
tableNote: Tap a rhythm while negotiating, offer a short sample tune, and ask which stories the village tells about itself. Wenric needs his next booking and hopes a memorable song will make his name.
adventureHook: His newest song describes a robbery in suspicious detail, and the bandits want to know his source. Wenric needs an escort to his next performance and help finding the storyteller first.
imageAlt: Smiling auburn-haired halfling bard in a patched rust and teal coat holding a battered lute beside a village tavern porch.

name: Captain Mara Thornwick
subtitle: Safe passage has a price
summary: Charming in town and threatening on the road, Mara buys strangers drinks while her crew assesses their purses and travel plans. She prefers easy targets and abandons a fight when the cost outweighs the gain.
tableNote: Offer a friendly bargain, ask casually when travelers leave, and keep an escape route in sight. Mara wants steady income from intimidation, but a reckless crew member is undermining her promises.
adventureHook: Mara offers safe passage for a fee, but someone in her crew robs travelers who have already paid. She proposes a temporary truce if the party helps expose the culprit.
imageAlt: Confident dark-haired human bandit captain in weathered charcoal leather armour and a faded burgundy scarf beside a wooded road, with one hand near her belt.

name: Nibbin Copperwheel
subtitle: Every bargain has a story
summary: Cheerful and shrewd, Nibbin sells practical supplies and peculiar bargains from a cluttered wagon. He remembers every customer—and what they bought.
tableNote: Rub your palms together, greet returning customers by their last purchase, and offer a practical bargain before an oddity. Nibbin wants repeat customers, but his careful inventory cannot explain the knocking beneath his wagon.
adventureHook: Something hidden beneath his wagon starts knocking. He insists it wasn’t there yesterday.
imageAlt: Cheerful green-skinned goblin merchant with long ears and a patched ochre coat holding copper scales beside a cluttered supply wagon.

name: Elra Duskbrook
subtitle: A silver pendant for a few coins
summary: Exhausted and nervous, Elra offers a silver pendant for far less than its value. She stole it to pay for her brother’s medicine.
tableNote: Twist your apron, speak quickly when naming the price, and avoid looking at the pendant. Elra needs medicine for her brother today; she will admit the theft if someone offers a way to help without abandoning him.
adventureHook: The pendant bears a local noble’s crest, and its owner is searching for it.
imageAlt: Tired human laborer with tied-back brown hair, a patched slate dress and linen apron holding a small silver pendant in a village market.

name: Sergeant Harl Fenwick
subtitle: Patient questions, watchful eyes
summary: A patient but watchful guard on patrol, Harl questions unfamiliar travelers about their names, business, and recent movements. He listens for details that do not fit.
tableNote: Ask one calm question at a time, repeat exact names, and pause when an account changes. Harl wants a fair investigation; missing watch records trouble him more than an easy arrest.
adventureHook: He is investigating the theft of a noble-crested pendant but suspects someone is using it to cover a more serious crime. He asks travelers to compare what they saw with a watch log that has a page torn out.
imageAlt: Watchful middle-aged human guard with greying hair and a moustache in worn mail and a burgundy surcoat holding an iron helmet near a village watchhouse.

name: Pippa Reed
subtitle: Have you ever seen a dragon?
summary: Curious and endlessly talkative, Pippa follows newcomers, asking about their weapons, travels, and whether they have ever seen a dragon. Her freckled face lights up at any story worth repeating.
tableNote: Fire off questions, mime a dragon with your hands, and interrupt yourself with a new detail. Pippa wants a true adventure story and is proud of noticing things adults overlook; her carved wooden dragon goes everywhere with her.
adventureHook: Pippa saw someone slip a wrapped parcel beneath a merchant’s wagon while the guard was busy asking questions. She can point out the muddy shortcut they took, but first wants to hear whether the party has ever seen a real dragon.
imageAlt: Freckled human village girl with auburn braids, a sage tunic and patched brown vest holding a carved wooden dragon on a cottage-lined lane.

name: Harl “Split Lip” Mercer
subtitle: One ale from another argument
summary: A muddy farmhand who drinks away his wages and takes any mention of his brother as an invitation to fight. Tousled brown hair, an old split lip and a frayed waistcoat mark a man who would rather look angry than admit he is worried.
tableNote: Grip your mug with both hands, laugh too loudly at small jokes, and stiffen at talk of family. Harl's brother owes the miller money; Harl is working extra shifts to keep their mother from losing her cottage.
adventureHook: The miller's men are coming to take his mother's furniture at dawn. Harl offers three days of field work if someone helps him find his brother and the missing wages before then.
imageAlt: Tousle-haired human farmhand with an old split lip, muddy linen shirt and frayed waistcoat holding a wooden ale mug in a village tavern.

name: Mara Flint
subtitle: Soot, silence and a single ale
summary: A charcoal burner who sits near the door, nursing one ale all evening and listening for work worth taking. Soot-smudged cheeks and a patched wool coat betray long days in the woods; she expects payment before promises.
tableNote: Let others fill the silence, warm your hands around a cup, and ask what a job pays before anything else. Mara is saving to replace her cracked charcoal cart and will not risk it on a stranger's vague assurances.
adventureHook: Mara saw a cart unload sacks at the abandoned limekiln after midnight, but nobody has bought fuel for it in months. She will describe the driver and route in exchange for help repairing her axle.
imageAlt: Soot-smudged human charcoal burner with tied-back dark hair and a patched charcoal-grey coat holding an earthenware cup near a village tavern door.

name: Jory Pike
subtitle: Fresh meat and borrowed excuses
summary: A poacher with a lame hunting dog beneath his stool who trades fresh meat for ale and keeps watch for the village reeve. A battered felt cap and patched coat suit a wiry man who knows every gap in the estate fence.
tableNote: Check the door between sentences, tuck scraps aside for your dog, and call every deer a rabbit. Jory poaches to feed himself and his old hound, but his snares have lately caught someone else's attention.
adventureHook: Someone is moving Jory's snares onto the public footpath, and a child has already been hurt. He can show the sites, but confronting the reeve would mean admitting whose traps they are.
imageAlt: Wiry human poacher with a greying beard, battered brown felt cap and patched olive jerkin resting a hand on an ale mug in a village tavern.

name: Bess Crowley
subtitle: Nothing washes out a good rumour
summary: A washerwoman with cracked hands and a vicious sense of humour who knows whose blood she scrubbed out this morning. A plain kerchief, faded burgundy dress and worn apron accompany a regular who can puncture a boast with one sentence.
tableNote: Dry your hands on your apron, deliver insults without raising your voice, and become brisk when someone is genuinely frightened. Bess protects her customers' privacy, but keeping quiet about this morning's laundry is beginning to trouble her.
adventureHook: A local carter paid Bess double to clean a bloodied coat before his wife saw it. When she learns that the miller's apprentice is missing, she asks the party to check his yard before she names him in public.
imageAlt: Grey-haired human washerwoman in a cream kerchief, faded burgundy dress and worn linen apron with rough hands and a knowing smile in a village tavern.

name: Cassian Holt
subtitle: Fallen nobility
summary: Seeking adventure and riches to restore his fallen house.
tableNote: Courteous, but sensitive about his family name.
adventureHook: He needs companions to recover a lost family heirloom.
imageAlt: Cassian Holt in a red cloak and dark armor in a sunlit city

name: Mira Fen
subtitle: Herbalist and healer
summary: A precise apothecary whose remedies carry a hint of old magic.
tableNote: Warm and observant; she remembers every favor.
adventureHook: A rare moonflower she needs grows beyond the old city walls.
imageAlt: Mira Fen surrounded by bottles and herbs in her apothecary

name: Brother Alden
subtitle: Keeper of the dawn chapel
summary: A steadfast priest protecting a secret beneath his quiet chapel.
tableNote: Speaks gently and pauses before answering direct questions.
adventureHook: The chapel bells ring each midnight, though no one pulls the ropes.
imageAlt: Brother Alden in pale ceremonial robes before a tall chapel window

name: Nessa Vale
subtitle: Harbor runner
summary: A daring smuggler who knows every hidden route through the harbor.
tableNote: Quick to laugh, quicker to notice an unguarded purse.
adventureHook: One of her trusted routes has begun delivering ships to the wrong coast.
imageAlt: Nessa Vale in a dark leather coat overlooking a busy harbor

name: Wenrin Duskshield
subtitle: Weary keeper of the gate
summary: Dutiful, watchful and weary, Wenrin keeps the town guard disciplined while quietly shouldering every missed patrol and sleepless night. Practical armor and a burgundy cloak mark a captain who values service above ceremony.
tableNote: Scan the room before speaking. Keep instructions short, rub a tired brow, and show relief when someone follows through.
adventureHook: A patrol has failed to return from an abandoned watchtower. Wenrin needs discreet help before panic spreads.
imageAlt: Human guard captain with graying hair, practical armor and a burgundy cloak before a fortified gate.

name: Harira Ashhaven
subtitle: A welcome and a watchful eye
summary: Warm and observant, Harira runs a comfortable inn where travelers find good food and a listener who remembers their names. Curly chestnut hair, a waistcoat and an apron give her an approachable air; little escapes her attention.
tableNote: Offer food before questions. Notice small changes in a guest’s mood, and share useful information without embarrassing anyone.
adventureHook: A guest vanished overnight, leaving a paid room, untouched breakfast and a coded note tucked beneath a plate.
imageAlt: Curly-haired innkeeper in a waistcoat and apron standing inside a warmly lit timber inn.

name: Norzor Stormfield
subtitle: Pride in every rivet
summary: Proud and dependable, Norzor judges work by how well it survives hard use. A braided auburn beard and a scarred leather apron frame a craftsperson whose promises are as solid as the tools leaving the forge.
tableNote: Test the weight of anything handed over. Praise good workmanship plainly; grumble at shortcuts, then explain how to fix them.
adventureHook: A shipment of ore contains a metal that will not cool. Norzor wants its source investigated before anyone uses it.
imageAlt: Auburn-bearded blacksmith in a leather work apron beside an anvil and glowing forge.

name: Aretha Frostcrest
subtitle: One more unanswered question
summary: Curious and easily distracted, Aretha follows intriguing details even when a conversation has moved on. Blue-gray robes, ink-stained fingers and a worn book reveal a scholar more interested in discoveries than appearances.
tableNote: Interrupt yourself with a new connection, mark a page with whatever is nearby, and become sharply focused when evidence appears.
adventureHook: A marginal note in an old book describes a room missing from every surviving map of a ruined observatory.
imageAlt: Dark-haired elven scholar in blue-gray robes holding a worn book in a sunlit library.

name: Sergorn Wolffall
subtitle: The steady pathfinder
summary: Quiet and reliable, Sergorn knows when to keep moving and when the woods are asking travelers to stop. An olive cloak, worn leather gear and an attentive expression suit a guide who earns trust through careful preparation.
tableNote: Listen before answering. Point out tracks and weather changes with few words; check everyone’s gear without making a fuss.
adventureHook: Fresh tracks circle a remote camp but never approach or leave it. Sergorn needs companions to find out what is watching.
imageAlt: Wilderness guide in an olive cloak and worn leather gear with a walking staff against forested mountains.

name: Elmir Valebrook
subtitle: A fair measure and a better story
summary: Cheerful and persuasive, Elmir can make a humble purchase feel like a lucky discovery. Copper curls, a plum coat and a small brass balance scale accompany a merchant who takes pride in finding the right goods for the right buyer.
tableNote: Ask what the customer needs before naming a price. Tell a short story about each item, and weigh goods with deliberate care.
adventureHook: A consignment arrived with one sealed parcel that appears on no invoice. Someone is offering far too much for it.
imageAlt: Copper-curled merchant in a plum coat holding a small brass balance scale at an outdoor market.

name: Harthos Ravenmoor
subtitle: Patient keeper of the crossing
summary: Patient and practical, Harthos carries people across the river with steady hands and little ceremony. Weathered clothing and a wooden ferry pole reflect years spent reading currents and making room for one more traveler.
tableNote: Allow comfortable silences. Check the river while talking, explain hazards matter-of-factly, and never rush a frightened passenger.
adventureHook: The ferry keeps drifting toward a submerged stone arch against the current. Harthos wants someone to learn what lies below.
imageAlt: Orc ferryman in weathered clothing holding a wooden ferry pole beside a calm river.

name: Valaris Blackwhisper
subtitle: Discretion among the headstones
summary: Respectful and discreet, Valaris tends graves with the same care given to the living who visit them. A simple hood, work gloves and a shovel identify someone trusted with difficult tasks and stories best left unspoken.
tableNote: Lower your voice near mourners. Ask permission before touching keepsakes, and answer questions carefully without turning grief into gossip.
adventureHook: A newly filled grave is neatly reopened each dawn, yet no tracks disturb the surrounding earth. Valaris asks for a quiet investigation.
imageAlt: Hooded gravedigger in work gloves holding a shovel among headstones and trees.

name: Kaelen Ashford
subtitle: Honour beyond the crown
summary: Resolute and protective, Kaelen wants to redeem himself without serving another corrupt lord. Battered plate armour, a burgundy cloak and a broken heraldic badge mark a knight who has lost his station but refuses to abandon his principles.
tableNote: Stand between others and danger. Speak plainly, avoid claiming authority, and hesitate when asked whom you once served.
adventureHook: He must rescue the heir whose disappearance he was blamed for—and needs allies willing to defy the crown.
imageAlt: Human knight with short dark hair, battered plate armour, a burgundy cloak and a broken heraldic badge in a ruined castle courtyard.

name: Seren Dawnsong
subtitle: Freedom at a dangerous price
summary: Charismatic and reckless, Seren fights to free her city from an order she once belonged to. Ivory travelling robes, dark leather bracers and singed silver hair reveal a mage whose convictions have already cost her dearly.
tableNote: Speak with infectious confidence. Treat cautious plans as challenges, but become quiet when civilians might bear the cost.
adventureHook: She has stolen the key to the city’s magical defences, but using it could endanger the people she hopes to save.
imageAlt: Silver-haired elven rebel mage in ivory travelling robes and leather bracers in a medieval city alley.

name: Rurik Stoneward
subtitle: The road back to the mountain
summary: Steadfast and stubborn, Rurik is determined to reclaim his clan’s lost home. Weathered mail, a braided black beard and an ancestral axe accompany a leader who carries both the expedition’s hopes and the weight of its losses.
tableNote: Check supplies before making promises. Remember each companion’s strengths, and resist suggestions that the lost hold should stay buried.
adventureHook: Something inside the mountain is answering his signal fires. He believes survivors remain; his companions fear a trap.
imageAlt: Black-bearded dwarf expedition leader in weathered mail holding an ancestral axe before an ancient mountain gate.

name: Nyra Valecrest
subtitle: The truth behind the quarry
summary: Resourceful and guarded, Nyra hunts creatures others dismiss as folklore. Charcoal leather armour, swept-back horns and a scar across one eyebrow frame a hunter willing to question whether the supposed monster is the real threat.
tableNote: Study tracks and exits while talking. Ask for evidence before accepting a story, and show unexpected patience toward frightened strangers.
adventureHook: She discovers that her latest quarry protects a village—and that her employer wants the village destroyed.
imageAlt: Tiefling monster hunter with swept-back horns, a scar across one eyebrow and charcoal leather armour on a woodland trail.
